bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
for cmd in pnpm npm npx node esbuild; do if command -v "$cmd" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "TOOL_$cmd=YES"; else echo "TOOL_$cmd=NO"; fi; done
for p in node_modules/.bin/esbuild artifacts/bot/node_modules/.bin/esbuild node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild; do if test -x "$p"; then echo "BUILD_TOOL=$p"; fi; done
for c in deploy-gaybbs-1 deploy-gaybbs-db-1 deploy-postgres-1; do if docker inspect "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "CONTAINER_$c=YES"; fi; done
echo "TOOL_CHECK_FINISHED"
